_comment: What the food trade says on the timeline.
THESE ARE BARE MINIMUM'S OWN VOICES, not Hoodrich's. Hoodrich's feed is the block
talking about itself -- sets, corners, who did what to who. This is the people who
sell you lunch: a hot dog man with opinions about the weather, a buffet that has
never once undersold itself, and a corner store that has been closing down for
three weeks. Different register on purpose. A shop that posted like a gang member
would read as the same system wearing a hat.
NOTHING HERE HAPPENS UNLESS HOODRICH IS INSTALLED. Bare Minimum has no feed of its
own and is not growing one; it hands a finished post to Hoodrich's and stays out of
the way. With Hoodrich absent the whole file is never even read.
authors   who posts. handle and name are what the timeline shows.
'vendor' ties an author to a vendor id in vendors.json, so the hot dog
man's account only ever posts about the hot dog stand.
'gang' is left empty: none of these people are in one.
posts     sets of lines, keyed by what just happened.
ambient    nothing in particular, they just posted.
bought     you have just bought something from them.
closing    they are shutting for the night.
opening    they are back on.
away       they have stepped off the pitch for a minute.
slots     {word} substitutions, picked at random. Same idea as Hoodrich's.
{shop} is always the vendor's own name, so one line serves every stall without
any of them sounding like the others.

complaint: people asking for the wifi password
a man who wanted it well done
the guy who parks across my pitch

ambient: Cart is out. Come get one before I eat the stock myself.
Somebody asked me today if the hot dogs are vegan. They are hot dogs.
Third person {timeofday} has asked if I take card. I do not.
{shop} is {praise} and I will not be taking questions.
If you are reading this you are already too far from {shop}.
We do not do small portions. We did once. It went badly.
Fresh today. Fresher than yesterday, anyway.
New sign went up. Same food. Same prices. Same guy.
Everything is going. Everything must go. Some of it should have gone last week.
All you can eat means all YOU can eat. Not all your cousin can eat.
Reminder that we have a menu and you are allowed to read it before you get to the front.
Whoever left a scooter across my pitch: I know what you look like.
bought: Big order just went out. Somebody out there is having a day.
The {item} is moving today. Get in while it is still warm.
Just served a guy who did not say a word. Respect.
That is the last of the {item} for now. Come back later.
Somebody paid full price and did not complain. Framing the receipt.
closing: That is me done. Back in the morning.
Packing up. If you are running down the street right now, you are too late.
opening: Back on the corner. Missed you.
Grill is on. Give it ten minutes.
We are open and I have already had an argument. Good start.
away: Stepped away for two minutes. Two. Minutes.
Having a cigarette. The cart is not going anywhere and neither am I.
Back in five. Do not touch anything.
